failure_reason: The required prochatgpt_researcher remained running until the 90-minute runtime limit without returning research findings. The scientific, websearcher, and product researchers were queued behind it and never executed, so no inspectable clinical, regulatory, trial, or product-information evidence was collected.
administrator_conclusions: This run did not establish any evidence-backed clinical conclusion. The planned coverage was appropriate for the request: pure lipedema; venous and lymphatic edema; idiopathic/orthostatic edema; heart failure; kidney disease; cirrhosis/ascites; and hypertension, with separate review of loop, thiazide/thiazide-like, mineralocorticoid-receptor antagonist, other potassium-sparing, acetazolamide, and SGLT2 medicines. It also planned direct verification of ESC, AHA/ACC/HFSA, KDIGO, EASL, ISL, German S2k, EMA, and AEMPS/CIMA sources; systematic reviews, primary trials, withdrawal/deprescribing evidence, monitoring, urgent signs, and the existence or absence of a lipedema-specific diuretic trial. However, only researcher-job metadata and the submitted prompts were preserved. No source page, guideline, PMID/DOI, trial record, regulator document, or product information was returned or inspected. Therefore it would be unsafe to state whether diuretics benefit or harm lipedema, whether a lipedema-specific trial exists, when any diuretic class is indicated, or how to interpret swelling after withdrawal. The requested falsation pass concerning “diuretics always worsen lipedema,” MRA/SGLT2 mechanisms, and rebound versus recurrence also remains entirely unperformed. The result is a blocked/failed research run rather than a negative finding: absence of returned evidence here must not be interpreted as evidence that trials or guidance do not exist. A new run should prioritize independent scientific and official-web retrieval first, while retaining the required Pro researcher as a separate long-running task, so that one stalled browser job cannot prevent collection and auditing of the core evidence.
